decision.thesis: All cash, the forty-fourth all-cash row. The 2026-10-28 feedback page decomposes Wednesday: no book name significant at 5%; Genting rose 4.14% to 1.51 at 1.87 sigma (idiosyncratic +4.28%, rank p 0.038), its third rise in a row, with no row about the company in the session and Genting Malaysia up 6.09% the same day, so a group leg is as likely as a Genting story and no cached proxy can tell them apart. Every other name moved within normal variation. Genting's 10-26 rise and Press Metal's 10-23 fall remain unexplained after the web searches. Microsoft reported after the 10-28 close; its first session after the results is 10-29, not yet decomposed. Alpha Vantage's news call is now a paid endpoint for this key, so the US names lost one sentiment source. No name carries a measured, sourced reason to expect it to beat cash over 21 sessions. Nineteen all-cash claims are graded, all correct, against a control at -4.48%. Claim: nothing in the fundable universe beats cash over 21 sessions.
